simple.meaning: כֶּסֶל (keçel) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H3689). BibleIQ follows its 13 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Leviticus, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, beginning at Leviticus 3:4. The occurrence trail shows where the place enters the biblical story.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name כֶּסֶל (H3689).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.

structuredEvidence.definition: properly, fatness , i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera ; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust

definitions.full: H3689. kesel כֶּ֫סֶל noun masculine 1 loins , 2 stupidity , 3 confidence (Late Hebrew id. lion ; Aramaic כִּסְלָא id. ); — 1 loins כָּ֑סֶל Job 15:27 ; plural כְּסָלִים Lev 3:4 , 10 , 15 ; 4:9 ; 7:4 ; suffix כְּסָלַי , Psa 38:8 . 2 stupidity, folly ׳כ Eccl 7:25 (|| סִכְלוּת ), כֵּסֶל Psa 49:14 . 3 confidence , suffix כִּסְלִי Job 31:24 ; כִּסְלֶ֑ךָ Prov 3:26 ; כִּסְלוֺ Job 8:14 ; כִּסְלָם Psa 78:7 .
